footer.intro: Opening hospitality to ability, potential, and meaningful work.
footer.closing: Designed for a more inclusive world of work.

welcome.heroText: JoIn connects candidates and hospitality employers through a clearer, more human way of matching people to the work they can thrive in.
welcome.matchingTitle: A clear view of job compatibility
welcome.matchingText: JoIn compares structured information rather than making assumptions about a person.

matchingSteps.title: Remaining abilities
matchingSteps.text: The candidate confirms practical abilities, education, and preferences.

matchingSteps.title: Hospitality job tasks
matchingSteps.text: The employer identifies the real duties and important tasks of the vacancy.

matchingSteps.title: Workplace support
matchingSteps.text: Available assistance is considered before compatibility is calculated.

welcome.matchingNote: The result remains transparent, reviewable, and based on real tasks.
welcome.visionText: A world where abilities define opportunities, and every person has equal access to meaningful employment, dignity, and independence.
welcome.missionText: To empower persons with disabilities through accessible technology, inclusive recruitment, and ability-based job matching that connects talent with opportunity.
welcome.purposeTitle: Work becomes more inclusive when we ask a better question.
welcome.purposeOne: Instead of asking what someone cannot do, we help employers understand what a person can contribute. That shift turns uncertainty into practical opportunity.
welcome.purposeTwo: JoIn makes hospitality roles easier to understand by connecting job tasks with real abilities—giving candidates confidence and employers clarity.

principles.title: Ability first
principles.text: We start with strengths and practical capabilities—not labels or assumptions.

principles.title: Clear by design
principles.text: Jobs, tasks, and expectations are presented in a way people can understand.

principles.title: Human at heart
principles.text: Technology supports better decisions while people remain at the center.

welcome.howTitle: A thoughtful path from potential to opportunity.
welcome.howText: Simple steps, clearer information, and matching built around the work itself.

steps.title: Share what you can do
steps.text: Candidates build an ability-led profile focused on strengths, preferences, and practical potential.

steps.title: Describe the real work
steps.text: Employers break opportunities into clear tasks and the abilities each task actually requires.

steps.title: Discover better matches
steps.text: Our platform brings both sides together with transparent, task-based compatibility insights.

welcome.employerTitle: Hire with more clarity and confidence.
welcome.employerText: Describe the work that matters, reach a wider talent pool, and focus hiring decisions on capability.
welcome.closingKicker: A more inclusive future of work
welcome.closingTitle: Ready to turn potential into possibility?
welcome.closingText: Join a community that sees ability first.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: How we use, protect, retain, and let you control your information.

sections.title: What we process
sections.text: We process account and contact details, candidate profile information, selected abilities, job applications, and documents you choose to upload. Candidate disability cards are used only to verify eligibility and are available only to authorized verifiers and administrators.

sections.title: Disability-card retention
sections.text: Cards are stored outside the public web directory with randomized filenames. After an authorized verifier records a decision, the card is scheduled for deletion after 30 days. The verification result and limited audit record remain so the account can continue to operate.

sections.title: AI-assisted profiles
sections.text: The editable text you approve is sent to the profile assistant only when you give explicit consent. Suggestions are reviewable and never update the profile automatically. The platform records consent and operational event metadata, not the transcript content.

sections.title: Your controls
sections.text: Candidates can download a machine-readable copy of their data, withdraw active AI consent, view card-retention status, and permanently delete their account and private documents from the Privacy & data dashboard.

sections.title: Security and access
sections.text: Private documents are served only through authenticated, role-authorized endpoints. Document responses disable browser caching, and access to disability cards is audited.
